python -c 'import tomlkit.convert; import tomlkit' && python - <<'PY'
from tomlkit import parse, dumps, to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table
s='[a] # header\nx = 1\n[a.b]\ny = 2\n'
d=parse(s); original=d.unwrap()
for fn in (to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table):
 print(fn.__name__)
 assert fn('a', d) is d
 print(dumps(d))
 assert parse(dumps(d)).unwrap() == original
print('conversion round trip passed')
